title: Bad junta node decision
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, let $P$ be a finite set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin}(n)$, and let $z$ assign signs to the coordinates in $P$. An optional node decision is bad if it is absent, or, when present, if it is not correct for the restriction of $f$ determined by $P$ and $z$.
